references.text: The priest who presents someone's burnt offering shall have the skin of the burnt offering that he has presented.
Moses cut up the ram and burned the head, the pieces, and the fat.
They handed him the burnt offering piece by piece, along with the head, and he burned it on the altar.
You shall cut up the ram, wash the entrails and the legs, and place them on top of the pieces and the head.
The prophet Ezekiel describes similar sacrificial actions involving the cutting up of the sacrifice animal.
Contrast between ritual division for the sake of the offering and the division of judgment as punishment.
Direct continuation and specification of the skinning and dividing procedure.
